title: Hungary at a Crossroads: Corruption Probes and a Fragile Recovery Test the… · 04 Sep
keywords: Hungary, Eximbank, corruption probe, anti-corruption, Orbán, GDP growth, inflation, HICP, economic recovery, European Union, rule of law, EU funds, Hungarian politics, cost of living, disinflation
notes: Hungary's new government is pursuing a criminal investigation into alleged abuses at the state-owned Eximbank, while the broader economy posts modest growth against a backdrop of lingering household pressure. The twin challenges of institutional accountability and an uneven economic recovery are defining the early character of the post-Orbán political era. How Budapest navigates both will have consequences not only for Hungarian citizens but for the country's standing with the European Union.
